parse.label: two pairs give two cookies
pairs without a space split at the semicolon
spaces and tabs at the start of a pair are removed
spaces and tabs at the end of a pair are removed
spaces inside a pair are kept
only spaces and tabs are removed: a line feed, a vertical tab and a carriage return stay
the first cookie of a name counts
the order is the order in which each name first gives a cookie
a pair without an equals sign gives no cookie
a pair with an empty name gives no cookie
a lone equals sign gives no cookie
a pair splits at its first equals sign
an empty value is a cookie
the value is percent-decoded and a plus is kept
hexadecimal digits of either case decode
a percent without two hexadecimal digits is itself
a decoded percent is not decoded again
an encoded semicolon, equals sign, space and quote are bytes of the value
a decoded NUL is a character of the value
the name is not decoded
dots, spaces and brackets of a name are kept
a decimal name is text
a value that is not UTF-8 gives no cookie, and a later pair of its name counts
a raw byte of a value that is not UTF-8 gives no cookie
an overlong encoding and the encoding of a surrogate are not UTF-8
a name that is not UTF-8 gives no cookie
a name that is not UTF-8 gives no cookie, and a later pair of a valid name counts
the UTF-8 bytes of a value are its text
the UTF-8 bytes of a name are its text
a comma is part of a value
quotes are part of a value
empty pairs give no cookie
a pair of spaces and tabs gives no cookie
an empty line gives no cookies
a request without the field gives no cookies
a leading U+FEFF of a value is a character of the value
the lines are read one after another
the first cookie of a name counts across lines
a pair does not cross the end of a line
the end of a line ends a pair, and its spaces are removed
empty lines give no cookies
